review_scope: Light English Game view at 2400x1334 and actual live Unity window; not an exhaustive physical-control or accuracy evaluation
observations: Final enabled screenshot visibly shows the light dashboard, large road image, four white region cards, controls and complete seven-state legend without clipping.
Video is displayed in road-view mode: the 150-pixel export metadata header is hidden only in the UI; the original 1280x720 road image and source timestamp remain visible.
Timeline explicitly labels ROAD REGION and SOURCE VIDEO TIME (MINUTES), with 0–60 tick marks and a cross-row current-time cursor.
Card units explicitly distinguish mean vehicles, image motion in px/s and motion coverage in percent.
Live Unity observation also showed readable normal controls and a selected 32:00–32:10 window. User interaction is not claimed as an automated button-click test.

The final opt-in integration run passed all 11 player API checks; controls were disabled during assertions and restored before the final screenshot. Prior dark-UI click evidence is recorded separately.
end_seek_limitation: End seeks to the final segment and may land one source frame before the last frame. Unity navigation frame numbers are not source frame indices, and its time is not an exact source-PTS readout.
previous_ui_observations: English headings, four region cards, controls, state bands and legend visible without clipping in the actual maximised Unity Game view.
Counts and states at windows 0, 324 and 325 matched the JSON when checked against live screenshots.

A real CUA click on Play advanced the video and changed the displayed window from 324 to 325. A later Pause click could not be confirmed because the UI automation tool reported noWindowsAvailable; pause itself was verified by the engine integration check.
